title: Orange Cream Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Fresh orange juice and zest go into unstrained yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon; no straining and no golden syrup.
summary: Bright orange juice and zest whisked into yoghurt for a frozen yoghurt that tastes like an orange ice lolly with cream.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk 370 g full-fat plain yoghurt, 360 ml fresh orange juice, 1 tbsp finely grated orange zest and 150 g caster sugar in a mixing bowl until the sugar is completely dissolved.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add 1 tbsp lemon juice and ¼ tsp fine salt a little at a time until the sweet and tart flavours are balanced to your taste.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill the mixture in an ice bath or fridge until it reaches 4 °C or colder.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Pour the chilled mixture into your pre-frozen ice-cream maker bowl and churn until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Transfer the mixture to a lidded freezer container and freeze for at least 4-5 h before serving.

tips: Squeeze the oranges just before mixing; bottled juice tastes flat once frozen.
Zest the oranges before you halve them, as it is much easier.
Serve in cones with a few segments of fresh orange.
storage: Keep in a lidded container in the freezer up to 5 days and soften 10-15 min at room temperature before scooping.
